prompt-failed.title: Could not prepare the action prompt.

context-overflow.body: The turn no longer fits in the model’s context window. Fork the chat to carry a summary into a fresh one.
context-overflow.title: This chat is too long

credentials.body: Sign in again or update this runtime’s API key, then send the turn again.
credentials.title: The provider rejected your credentials

network.body: The connection dropped before the turn finished. Check that you are online, then try again.
network.title: Could not reach the provider

provider-overloaded.body: The model’s servers returned an error. This usually clears on its own — try the turn again in a moment.
provider-overloaded.title: The provider is having trouble

provider-refused.body: The provider declined this request. Put the prompt back in the composer and reword it — sending the same words again earns the same refusal.
provider-refused.title: The model declined to answer

provider-truncated.body: The provider stopped mid-answer, so the reply above is incomplete. Continue to pick up where it stopped.
provider-truncated.title: The answer was cut off

rate-limit.body: This account has spent its plan window. Once the window resets, Continue picks the turn back up where it stopped.
rate-limit.body-open: The provider will not take another turn on this account. Wait for the limit to clear and press Continue, or check the plan and billing in settings.
rate-limit.title: You have hit a usage limit

runtime-crashed.body: The runtime exited before the turn finished. Sending the turn again starts it back up.
runtime-crashed.title: The agent process stopped

runtime-missing.body: Ensemblr could not run this provider’s command. Check its executable path in settings.
runtime-missing.title: The agent runtime is not available

session-closed.body: The turn could not be delivered because the session is already closed. Start a new chat to keep going.
session-closed.title: This session has ended

session-unresumable.body: The agent runtime no longer holds the conversation this chat was reloading, so its history could not be restored. A fresh conversation carries on from here.
session-unresumable.title: The runtime lost this conversation

tool-denied.body: The turn stopped because a tool was not allowed to run. Change the permission mode in this repository’s security settings, then continue.
tool-denied.title: A tool call was blocked

unknown.body: The runtime reported a failure it did not classify. Its own words are in the details below.
unknown.title: The turn ended with an error

workspace-invalid.body: The agent could not start in this workspace’s folder. Check that the folder still exists.
workspace-invalid.title: The workspace folder is not usable

failed.description: The harness could not be resumed.
failed.title: Could not restore agent
